svg.aria-label: Two side-by-side histograms: how a real image is assigned to eight synthetic prototypes, plus two summed, in a view and in the same view rotated by 90 degrees. The distributions overlap by 88 percent.
svg.title: Two side-by-side histograms: how a real image is assigned to eight synthetic prototypes, plus two summed, in a view and in the same view rotated by 90 degrees. The distributions overlap by 88 percent.
svg.text: A real image is soft-assigned to synthetic prototypes. View 2 is View 1 rotated by 90° (real image and prototypes alike).
The pixels differ between views, yet the same few prototypes receive most of the probability. Top eight of ten shown.

text.tspan: of the probability mass is shared by the two views

svg.text: Bar values are the assignment probabilities printed in the paper’s Fig. 1a; photos are CC0, prototypes are illustrative renderings.
